videos.script: This is the newest lesson in the course, about an API that is still a preview in Java 25. It answers a question the last six lessons left open. {{orphan}} When a page asks two services at once and one fails, what happens to the other? With the tools so far, nothing: it keeps running, finishes after the page has already reported the failure, and nobody is waiting for its answer. {{scope}} Structured concurrency gives concurrent tasks a scope, like a block of code gives variables one. Tasks forked inside it cannot outlive it. When one fails, the others are cancelled, and the scope reports one error. {{first}} The same shape answers a second question: ask three mirrors and keep the first answer. {{status}} Last, what preview means, and why this lesson will need revisiting when the API is final.
